verdict.rationale: Floot is an AI app-building platform, so official SDKs are a fair question, but the evidence pack never mentions an official SDK or client library. The documented programmatic surface is a remote MCP server with tools like get_logs and query_database, which is a different capability from SDKs. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
